get_model_by_name: get a pretrained ResNet-50 model by name with pretrained weights loaded
get_model_from_config: get a model from a config file path and load custom checkpoint weights
list_models_with_pattern: list all available ResNet models matching a wildcard pattern like resnet*in1k
inference_model_classification: inference an image with a pretrained model to get predicted class labels
ModelHub_register_model_index: register models from a model-index YAML file into the ModelHub registry
